Name: Em's Chickens
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Fifteen options for the chickens, including baby chicks and Marnie's shop icon
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative Textures
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

The different types are:
Orpington (blonde)
Leghorn (white)
Lohmann (brown and white)
Rhode (brown)
Polish (fluffy blonde)
Lakenveld (white and black)
Maron (brown and white)
Plymouth (black and white spotted)
Lavender (grey)
Silkie (fluffy white)
Hampshire (brown and black)
Rooster (green tail)
Void (black and red)
Blue (blue)
Gold (gold)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Chickens CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

When buying a chicken from Marnie, the type gets randomised and can be any of the fifteen options
If you rather choose which colour you add to your farm, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar

[/url]Alternatively, you can choose ﻿"Em's Chickens CP Config"
This allows you to choose one type for your farm with a config.json

The defaults are a [color=#e69138]Leghorn[/color] (white) and [color=#e69138]Lohmann[/color] (brown). To choose a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] in the chicken mod folder
Replace the "[color=#e69138]Type[/color]" with the name of the version you like
Save and close the file again, and you're all set!
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]
